# Implementation Plan: Redirect upstream install/update paths to the fork (gim-home/codex)
<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"codex-redirect-upstream-install-update-paths-to-fork"} -->


*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-05. Phase-4 reviewed (codex + copilot + claude; 11 findings converged). **HOLD for operator review of Open Questions before `/implement-with-ralph`.***

## Overview

The v0.135 network audit (`.ralph/investigations/codex-v135-network-audit/findings.md`, follow-ups F1+F2) found the codex fork still carries upstream OpenAI install/update references. One is a LIVE outbound path on the shipped Windows binary (`codex doctor` shells `curl` to `api.github.com/repos/openai/codex/releases/latest` + `formulae.brew.sh`, bypassing the fork's reqwest/no_proxy suppression). Others are latent (Unix-only daemon self-updater that pipes `chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh` to `sh`; user-facing install/update hint strings + a TUI update-notification cluster gated behind the already-no-opped `get_upgrade_version`). Research also surfaced a **functional fork bug**: `cli/src/doctor.rs::compare_npm_package_roots` hard-codes `@openai/codex`, so `codex doctor` reports `Fail` for every correct fork install.

Per operator decision, every upstream install/update reference is **redirected to the fork** (`gim-home/codex`) rather than silently no-opped — mirroring the discipline of the already-no-opped `tui/src/updates.rs` (`// SANDBOX PATCH:` markers, patch-surface registration, audit coverage) but pointing at the fork release/install path. Where no fork target exists (the Unix `install.sh` self-updater, the Homebrew cask), the reference is **neutralized** (the egress/remote-exec vector is removed). This is a network-suppression/redirect patch class; per fork core tenet #1 the established precedent for this class is INLINE upstream-canonical edits with markers, not overlays.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context

Call sites in `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/`:

1. **`cli/src/doctor/updates.rs` — LIVE on Windows.** Reached via `codex doctor` → `updates_check(config)` (line 33) → `fetch_latest_version` → `fetch_latest_github_release_version`/`fetch_homebrew_cask_version` → `http_get_json` → `run_command("curl", ["-fsSL","--max-time","5", url])` (line 178). One of the `tokio::join!` doctor checks (`cli/src/doctor.rs:373`); not gated by `check_for_update_on_startup`. Tokens: `GITHUB_LATEST_RELEASE_URL` (25), `HOMEBREW_CASK_API_URL` (26), `strip_prefix("rust-v")` (160), `update_action_label` hint strings `@openai/codex`/brew (132-140).
2. **`cli/src/doctor.rs` — FUNCTIONAL fork bug.** `compare_npm_package_roots` (986-1000) builds the npm target as `npm_root.join("@openai").join("codex")` (987). A fork install lives at `.../node_modules/@gim-home/codex` → comparison always `Mismatch` → both the `install` check (`doctor.rs:807-844`, summary string `@openai/codex` at 818) and the `updates` check (`updates.rs:50-86`) report Fail. Tests at `doctor.rs:3112,3124` pin `@openai/codex` paths. `npm_global_root_check`/`compare_npm_package_roots` is the single shared comparison point.
3. **`app-server-daemon/src/update_loop.rs:158` — latent, Unix-only.** `install_latest_standalone()` does `reqwest::get("https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh")` → pipes to `Command::new("/bin/sh").arg("-s")`. Whole module is `#[cfg(unix)]`; `#[cfg(not(unix))] run()` bails (71-74). The crate **compiles on Windows** (no platform exclusion); `run_pid_update_loop` is a real CLI subcommand, but the updater body is dead on the shipped Windows binary.
4. **Hint strings (informational):** `tui/src/update_action.rs` — `UpdateAction::command_args()` (38-61) returns npm/bun `@openai/codex`, brew, and Standalone Unix/Windows `curl ... chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh` / `irm ... install.ps1 | iex`; doc comments (11-20); two pinned tests (142-163). Executed by `cli/src/main.rs:705 run_update_action`, but inert because `tui/src/updates.rs::get_upgrade_version → None`. `app-server-daemon/src/lib.rs:664` — `ensure_managed_codex_bin` error string `curl ... install.sh | sh`. **`app-server-daemon/README.md:39`** also documents `curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh`.
5. **Latent TUI update-UI cluster (all behind the no-op):** `tui/src/history_cell/notices.rs:31,46,63,71` (`UpdateAvailableHistoryCell` renders `github.com/openai/codex` + `/releases/latest`), `tui/src/update_prompt.rs:207` (release-notes link), `tui/src/npm_registry.rs:5` (`PACKAGE_URL = registry.npmjs.org/@openai%2fcodex`), `tui/src/update_versions.rs:8` (`rust-v` parse), `tui/src/updates.rs:49,51` (dead `@openai/codex` consts). Their visible strings are asserted in `tui/src/history_cell/snapshots/` and `tui/src/snapshots/...update_prompt...snap`.

No-op precedent `tui/src/updates.rs`: `#![cfg(not(debug_assertions))]` + `// SANDBOX PATCH:` marker; `get_upgrade_version() -> None`; `#[allow(unused_imports)]`/`#[allow(dead_code)]` on now-dead imports/consts. File is in `KNOWN_PATCH_FILES`.

### Technical Constraints

- **Verification commands are repo-ruled.** `external/repos/codex-patched/AGENTS.md`: do NOT run `cargo test` directly — use `just test -p <crate>`; run `just fmt` after Rust edits and `just fix -p <project>` (scoped). `cargo check --workspace` remains the documented typecheck gate (codex/CLAUDE.md). Snapshot changes use `cargo insta accept -p codex-tui` after `just test -p codex-tui`.
- **`gim-home/codex` is INTERNAL visibility** → unauthenticated `curl api.github.com/repos/gim-home/codex/releases/latest` returns 404, which `updates_check` degrades to a **Warning** row (not Fail). This eliminates the upstream egress (the goal) but the version row is non-functional unless a `gh`/`GH_TOKEN` `Authorization` header is plumbed into the curl args. → OPEN QUESTION.
- **Fork release tags are `v0.135.0-copilot-api.1`** → `strip_prefix("rust-v")` must become `strip_prefix("v")`. `is_newer`/`parse_version` (updates.rs 182-195) parse only `major.minor.patch`, so the `-copilot-api.N` suffix yields `None` → "newer available" never fires. Pre-existing; note only (out of scope to "fix" comparison).
- **No fork brew cask** → neutralize the brew probe (the npm install method is what the fork uses on Windows; brew is never reached there).
- **No fork-hosted `install.sh`** → the Unix self-updater and `curl | sh` hints cannot be literally redirected. **`UpdateAction::command_args()` returns STATIC `(&'static str, &'static [&'static str])`** so the versioned primary flow `gh release download v<VERSION> --repo gim-home/codex` does not fit, and a bare `npm install -g @gim-home/codex` won't work for clean users (GitHub Packages needs registry + `read:packages` token). RECOMMENDED hint: point at the fork releases/install-docs URL `https://github.com/gim-home/codex/releases` (a static, always-correct pointer). → OPEN QUESTION 5.

### Build/verify (codex submodule)
`cargo check --workspace` (~6 min, LLVM/xwin env via `scripts/iteration-env.sh`) = Phase-5a gate; `just test -p codex-cli` / `-p codex-tui` / `-p codex-app-server-daemon`; `just fmt`; `just fix -p <project>`; `bash scripts/audit_network_calls.sh` + `bash scripts/audit_invariants.sh` (run in `.github/workflows/invariant-check.yml`); `cargo insta accept -p codex-tui` for snapshots. `cargo build --release` is CI-only.

## Approach

### Architecture

Follow the network-suppression patch class: INLINE upstream-canonical edits, each with a `// SANDBOX PATCH:` marker, registered in patch-surface §1/§14/§15 and covered by the audits. An overlay-const approach was considered and rejected (codex + copilot + architect concur): it does not reduce the count of edited upstream-canonical lines (each call site still needs an inline edit to reference the const) and adds `cli`/`tui`/`app-server-daemon` → overlay Cargo.toml dep-edges. Inline-with-marker matches precedent (`tui/src/updates.rs`, `tui/src/tooltips.rs`, `analytics/src/client.rs`).

Per-site action:
- **doctor probe + functional bug (US-001):** redirect `GITHUB_LATEST_RELEASE_URL` → `api.github.com/repos/gim-home/codex/releases/latest`; tag parse `strip_prefix("rust-v")`→`strip_prefix("v")` (extracted to a pure, unit-testable `parse_release_tag` helper); neutralize the brew probe; redirect `update_action_label` hints; **fix `compare_npm_package_roots` `@openai`→`@gim-home`** (987) + summary string (818) + tests (3112/3124).
- **Unix self-updater (US-002):** neutralize `install_latest_standalone()` to a no-op `Ok(())`, removing the `reqwest::get(chatgpt.com/...)` + `/bin/sh` pipe entirely (eliminates the egress, the remote-script-exec vector, and the literal). Drop the now-unused `#[cfg(unix)]` imports (`Stdio`/`AsyncWriteExt`/tokio `Command`) or `#[allow]` them.
- **Hint strings (US-003):** redirect `update_action.rs` npm/bun/brew/standalone commands + doc comments + the two pinned tests, the `lib.rs:664` error string, and `app-server-daemon/README.md:39`, to the fork releases/install-docs URL; refresh affected `tui` snapshots.
- **Audit/patch-surface registration (US-004):** see Audit-guard design below.
- **Latent TUI cluster (US-005, Scope B):** redirect `notices.rs`, `update_prompt.rs`, `npm_registry.rs` `PACKAGE_URL`, `update_versions.rs` `rust-v`, `updates.rs` dead consts; refresh snapshots; assert `get_upgrade_version` stays a no-op.

### Audit-guard design (US-004)
- **`KNOWN_PATCH_FILES` (audit_network_calls.sh) gets ONLY the true outbound call sites:** `cli/src/doctor/updates.rs`, `app-server-daemon/src/update_loop.rs` (+ descriptions). The string/functional files (`cli/src/doctor.rs`, `tui/src/update_action.rs`, `app-server-daemon/src/lib.rs`, the TUI cluster) are NOT added to `KNOWN_PATCH_FILES` (Phase 2 must keep scanning them for future outbound regressions); they carry `// SANDBOX PATCH:` markers and are enforced by file-scoped `audit_invariants.sh` guards instead.
- **`ENDPOINT_PATTERNS`:** add only `chatgpt\.com/codex/install` (catch a regression to the remote-script installer). `api\.github\.com/repos/openai/codex/releases` and `formulae\.brew\.sh` already exist. Do NOT add `@openai/codex` or bare `openai/codex` tree-wide — see guard over-breadth below.
- **`audit_invariants.sh` file-scoped guards** (`require_file_pattern`/`forbid_file_pattern` on specific files): require the fork URL/package present in `doctor/updates.rs` and `doctor.rs`; forbid `openai/codex/releases`, `@openai/codex`, `formulae.brew.sh`, and `chatgpt.com/codex/install` in each patched file. Wire the new `check_*` functions into the run list.
- **Guard over-breadth (corrected):** a tree-wide ban on `openai/codex` would false-positive on legitimate PR/issue/git-remote/doc-link refs (`tui/src/branch_summary.rs`, `tui/src/bottom_pane/feedback_view.rs`, `git-utils/src/info.rs`, `model-provider-info/src/lib.rs`, `thread-store/...`, `network-proxy/...`); a tree-wide ban on `@openai/codex` would false-positive on `tui` snapshots and (pre-patch) `update_action.rs`. Hence guards are file-scoped.
- **patch-surface:** §1 network-suppression rows for the two call-site files; §14 invariant rows (one per story, with the enforcing test/grep); §15 replant recipes (the per-site re-gut/re-redirect, esp. the HIGH-churn `update_loop.rs` + `lib.rs`).

### Implementation Strategy
Serial single impl member. Order: US-001 → US-002 → US-003 → US-004 → US-005 (if operator keeps Scope B). The per-story Rust files are disjoint, so parallel is technically possible, but serial single-member is recommended because (a) the change is small, (b) the audits are only green as an atomic set (no partial-ship benefit), and (c) the fork's `--parallel` impl path has known crews-stability issues. US-004 must land after US-001-003 (its registration references their markers/tests).

## Scope

### In Scope
- Redirect the LIVE `codex doctor` GitHub-releases probe to the fork; neutralize the brew probe; fix the `rust-v`→`v` tag parse.
- Fix the functional `compare_npm_package_roots` `@openai/codex`→`@gim-home/codex` bug (+ summary + pinned tests) so `codex doctor` stops falsely failing on correct fork installs.
- Redirect the doctor + `update_action.rs` + daemon `lib.rs` + `app-server-daemon/README.md` install/update hints to the fork releases/install-docs URL; refresh affected snapshots.
- Neutralize the Unix-only daemon self-updater remote-script-exec vector.
- Scope B (RECOMMENDED per operator's "EVERY"): redirect the latent TUI update-UI cluster + assert `get_upgrade_version` stays no-op.
- Full patch-surface (§1/§14/§15) + audit registration with file-scoped guards + invariant tests.

### Out of Scope
- "Fixing" `is_newer`/`parse_version` to compare `-copilot-api.N` suffixes (pre-existing; note only).
- The doctor curl-bypasses-HTTPS_PROXY concern (operator scoped this to redirect).
- The feedback→Sentry path (audit finding C; separate follow-up).
- Plumbing GitHub auth into the doctor curl (unless operator chooses it at OQ1).

## Risk Areas
- **Re-conflict on rebase** (the `doctor/` module + `app-server-daemon` crate are NEW in v0.135; upstream re-emits literals each rebase → re-apply per §15): `app-server-daemon/src/update_loop.rs` **HIGH** (full body re-gut), `app-server-daemon/src/lib.rs` **HIGH** (string re-emitted), `cli/src/doctor/updates.rs` + `cli/src/doctor.rs` **MEDIUM**, `tui/src/update_action.rs` + TUI cluster **LOW-MEDIUM**.
- **Dead-code fallout** in `update_loop.rs` after gutting (unused `#[cfg(unix)]` imports) — mirror the `tui/src/updates.rs` `#[allow]` precedent or remove imports.
- **CI builds `app-server-daemon` on ubuntu** (the `#[cfg(unix)]` path compiles there) — any Unix-gated test must not attempt network.
- **Snapshot churn:** changing visible TUI strings requires `cargo insta accept -p codex-tui`; missing this fails `just test -p codex-tui`.
- **Audit guard over-breadth** (file-scope all guards; no tree-wide `openai/codex`/`@openai/codex` ban — see Audit-guard design).
- **Internal-repo 404** makes the redirected doctor version row a Warning, not green (accepted; OQ1).

## Acceptance Criteria
- A targeted grep over the install/update surfaces finds NO live reference to `api.github.com/repos/openai/codex/releases`, `formulae.brew.sh`, `@openai/codex`, `registry.npmjs.org/@openai`, or `chatgpt.com/codex/install.{sh,ps1}` in: `cli/src/doctor/updates.rs`, `cli/src/doctor.rs`, `app-server-daemon/src/update_loop.rs`, `app-server-daemon/src/lib.rs`, `app-server-daemon/README.md`, `tui/src/update_action.rs`, and (Scope B) `tui/src/history_cell/notices.rs`, `tui/src/update_prompt.rs`, `tui/src/npm_registry.rs`, `tui/src/update_versions.rs`, `tui/src/updates.rs`. Redirected references name `gim-home/codex` / the fork releases URL, or the brew/Unix paths are neutralized with `// SANDBOX PATCH:` markers.
- `codex doctor`'s `install` and `updates` checks no longer falsely report `Fail` for a correct fork install: `compare_npm_package_roots` targets `@gim-home/codex`; the `doctor.rs:3112/3124` tests assert the fork package path.
- The doctor `updates` row degrades to **Warning** (not Fail) on the internal-repo 404 — accepted behavior; the upstream egress is eliminated.
- `tui/src/updates.rs::get_upgrade_version` remains a no-op (`None`); no Scope-B edit re-enables the update flow.
- `bash scripts/audit_network_calls.sh` passes with `cli/src/doctor/updates.rs` + `app-server-daemon/src/update_loop.rs` in `KNOWN_PATCH_FILES`, `chatgpt\.com/codex/install` in `ENDPOINT_PATTERNS`, and no NEW-endpoint findings (the string/functional files stay scannable by Phase 2).
- `bash scripts/audit_invariants.sh` passes with the new file-scoped guards (fork URL/package present; upstream install/release patterns absent in the patched files) — no tree-wide `@openai/codex`/`openai/codex` ban.
- `just test -p codex-cli` (doctor const + `parse_release_tag` + npm-root fork path), `just test -p codex-tui` (update_action command_args + refreshed snapshots), `just test -p codex-app-server-daemon` pass; `just fmt` + `just fix -p <project>` clean.
- `cargo check --workspace` green.
- patch-surface §1 + §14 rows + §15 replant notes added for each marked file.

- **US-002** Neutralize the Unix daemon self-updater remote-script-exec (`update_loop.rs`).
- **US-003** Redirect the user-facing install/update hint strings (`update_action.rs`, daemon `lib.rs`, `app-server-daemon/README.md`) to the fork releases/install-docs URL; refresh `tui` snapshots.
- **US-004** Patch-surface + audit registration: `KNOWN_PATCH_FILES` (call sites only), narrow `ENDPOINT_PATTERNS`, §1/§14/§15, file-scoped `audit_invariants.sh` guards.
- **US-005** (Scope B — RECOMMENDED per "EVERY"; operator may cut at HOLD) Redirect the latent TUI update-UI cluster + assert `get_upgrade_version` no-op; refresh snapshots.
